text:
Lara Patel: Quick heads-up 1: the API reference for POST /v1/embeddings still uses the old single-string example (\"input\": \"...\"). We should standardize examples + SDK snippets to use a batched request (\"inputs\": [...]) and add a short migration note.
Tom Nguyen: Got it. User filed a support ticket reporting confusion. Which files are affected?
Lara Patel: Found in docs/openapi/embeddings.yml -> example.request.body and docs/snippets/python/embeddings_example.py in the docs repo. Theres a draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812 (draft).
Praneet Iyer: The Python snippet currently does: client.embeddings.create(model=\"rwd-embed-1\", input=\"single string\"). Our runtime accepts both shapes but the canonical request shape is inputs array. Propose updating snippet to:
```py
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.embeddings.create(model=\"rwd-embed-1\", inputs=[\"s1\", \"s2\"])
print(resp.data)
```
Maria Gomez: Agreed. Also add a two-sentence migration note under Embeddings -> Request shape: \"Historically, a single-string 'input' was accepted for convenience. Examples now prefer 'inputs' array for batching; the single-string shape is still accepted for compatibility but may be removed from examples.\" Add a cURL example showing array payload too.
ci-bot: Lint error in PR #812: docs/openapi/embeddings.yml: example.request.body does not match schema (expected array vs object) at line 42.
docs-bot: Deploy preview failed: OpenAPI schema mismatch. See CI link in PR.
Tom Nguyen: I'll fix the OpenAPI example and update the curl + python snippet. Plan for example.request.body:
```json
{
  \"model\": \"rwd-embed-1\",
  \"inputs\": [\"The quick brown fox\", \"jumped over the lazy dog\"]
}
```
And update the python snippet as above.
Lara Patel: Please also add a single-line note in the SDK changelog linking to the migration note in the docs. Keep wording minimal.
Tom Nguyen: On it. Assigning to myself, targeting EOD.
Praneet Iyer: Quick sweep required: JS and Go snippets still have two spots passing 'input' as string. I can run a grep and submit a tiny follow-up PR after Tom merges.
Maria Gomez: Ill add the migration blurb and submit the changelog PR once Tom pushes.
Tom Nguyen: Pushed the fixes (openapi + python + curl) to the PR branch. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812/files
Praneet Iyer: Reviewed, left one nit about phrasing in the python docstring.
ci-bot: CI rerun queued for PR #812.
Tom Nguyen: CI passed and I merged the PR.
Maria Gomez: Changelog PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/813 — one-line note linking to the migration doc.
Lara Patel: Thanks team. Keep an eye on support for any follow-ups; if more users report confusion well add an FAQ entry under Embeddings.
Maria Gomez: Noted. Will watch support tickets and add FAQ if needed. :thumbsup:
